description: Defines the 'Article' class within the 'Conduit.Domain' namespace, representing an article entity with properties such as title, description, author, comments, tags, and favorites.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents an article with properties for content, metadata, relations, and computed attributes like favorites and tags.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Indicates whether the article has any favorites.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of favorites for the article.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Provides a list of tag identifiers associated with the article.
